get.description:
Same body as getRwaFacts. Robinhood Chain facts (`chain=4663` query) settle in
USDC on Base (`eip155:8453`, asset `0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913`,
amount `10000`, EIP-3009 `TransferWithAuthorization`). Facilitator is the
Coinbase CDP x402 API. The 402 carries `extensions.bazaar` for discovery.
Without a `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE` header the answer is 402 with
`PAYMENT-REQUIRED` (base64 JSON, also the body). 404, 422 and 503 carry
`charged: false`. `X-Payment-Status: settled` comes with `PAYMENT-RESPONSE`.
`X-Bazaar-Status` reflects CDP Bazaar indexing when present.

200.description: The reconstruction (same body as getRwaFacts). X-Payment-Status is `settled` (with PAYMENT-RESPONSE and optional X-Bazaar-Status) or `unknown`.

402.description: Payment required, refused, or settle answered success:false (PAYMENT-RESPONSE attached).

503.description: facilitator_unconfigured, too_busy, feed_unavailable or too_slow_retry (not charged)

get.summary: The same facts JSON, paid per call over x402 v2 in USDC on Base via CDP
